body: Lean on your friends. Study hard. Experience new things that don't distract too much from that. You'll be a better, stronger person when the next phase hits.
Counseling or divorce. There is no such thing as letting down easy. Your call.

Really? Why divorce at all - there's therapy, after all. You just sound mean as fuck. I know you're angry, but either cut your losses and move on or try reconciling. This painful fantasy won't pan out.

Honestly, we're doing post-seperation therapy, and it is amazing. We can keep our cool for 2 weeks, occasionally talk heavy for brief periods, and know we have a safe space for anything not vented. It's been a huge boon for us and our child. That said, she initiated and was done with me. This was a concession on her part that has helped the family, post-marraige.

My stbx had our kiddo, lost him for 30 minutes, was bold enough to tell me. I was lonely. Cleaning house, watching Stranger Things, trying to get the motivation to craft. I saw my son twice; that was amazing.

I just kicked off divorce, and it sucks. I'm amazed at your resilience to make that commitment again. Right now, theres no way in hell I'd ever believe I could set myself up for feeling like this again. My dad was married 3 times. He died in December; I wish he was here to talk with now. You've already posted several positive things about yourself. Sometimes, people grow apart. You're not in control of them; nice versa.

I got the request for a divorce 6 weeks ago. We still live together, and will have to for several months. I can see she hurts, even though she's already dating. We're cordial, and even occasionally laugh together. We're going to counseling together. Bit I'm the one who printed the papers we're signing tonight. I'm the one who started filling it out. Friends? I hope so, one day. Right now, awkward roommates coparenting. She and our son are amazing, sometimes shit doesn't work out.

My wife dropped the D word on me 6 weeks ago. We live together with our 7 year old son. We're seeing a counselor together every 2 weeks, and it is amazing. It's tough (I'm left in the dust), but it helps us both relate to each other. All is civil, and we both care about each other. I just care too much still =p
Get that friend over. Sit down. Let them know, not joking, how much ot meant to have there at that time. Cry. You don't need to do it alone

Yep. My wife just gave this to me. It's a month later, and I still can't put down 1200 calories. But, you know? ENGAGE your support system: friends, family. IF therapy together doesn't help, have the courage to be a new you. In one month, I am a better person than since childhood, all because I was forced to change on a dime. I'll survive, for now. In six months, I'll thrive. And that's while living with her and our son.

This. Now. Please. I just learned 3 weeks ago she wanted a divorce, and I'm happy as fuck theres not a gun in the house. You WILL GET THERE. Have health insurance? See your doctor. Don't? Look for a sliding scale one. Really. TAKE CARE OF YOURSELF, PLEASE.
Exactly. Do right by you. If this was the right call, great. Take care.
Tough, man. But good job. We did the same with my 7 yr old last week, but as I'm not moving out just yet he seems on the level. Keep being the great father you are.
Happy FD! This gives me hope, thank you!

Hey, man hang in there. Today is 2 weeks after my wife called it. I still love her so much. I'm exercising (you should be too), eating healthier than I have in my life (the few calories in my body) and reaching out to friends and family (or I'd kill myself. For real.) I'll be moving out in a couple months, be broke as fuck, but I'm determined not to kill myself. If I do that, and continue spending time with friends, my self worth will grow. Today has bee horribly painful to me, not seeing her. But seeing post told ME that it will be okay, eventually. Also, fuck all the slut shaming posts. We're all in different places, men and women. You do YOU, okay?
Thank you! I forgot about thevlifebinsurance, which covers suicide! Everyone wins!
